title: Finite bases pass to completed constant quotient sheaves
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site, $A\to B$ a homomorphism of commutative rings, and $b_1,\ldots,b_d$ an $A$-basis of $B$, with $d\geq0$. Let $t\in A$, $v\in B$, $u\in B^\times$ and $e\geq1$ satisfy $t=u v^e$ in $B$. Write $\underline{M}$ for the constant sheaf associated to an abelian group or ring $M$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Put $R=\lim_{n\geq1}\underline{A/t^nA}$ and $S=\lim_{m\geq1}\underline{B/v^mB}$. There is a unique ring map $R\to S$ whose $m$-th projection is $R\to\underline{A/t^mA}\to\underline{B/v^mB}$. Inverse limits are sectionwise [def-pur-sheaf-inverse-limit]. The basis maps on the quotients induce an $R$-linear isomorphism $R^{\oplus d}\xrightarrow{\sim}S$, with $i$-th column the compatible residues of $b_i$. Its projection at $m=en$ is the basis isomorphism $\underline{A/t^nA}^{\oplus d}\cong\underline{B/t^nB}=\underline{B/v^{en}B}$.

source.place: Lemma 6.8.2(1), pp. 58-59: inverse limits of constant quotient sheaves. The basis and cofinal-filtration refinement below is an agent argument, not a numbered assertion of the source.
